name: Attribution MCP
description:
Attribution's connector lets you query your marketing performance in plain English, with no dashboards to navigate or CSVs to export. Ask a question and Claude pulls the answer straight from your Attribution project.

Because Attribution ties real ad spend to each user's journey across every channel, the numbers you get back are deduplicated and reconcile with actual revenue, not platform-reported estimates.

What you can do:
- Pull dashboard reports with spend, visits, conversions, revenue, and ROAS by channel
- Run period-over-period comparisons to see what changed versus last month, quarter, or year, with per-channel deltas and the biggest gains and drops
- View results under any attribution model: first touch, last touch, linear, time decay, or position-based
- Explore your channel and filter hierarchy, from top-level channels down to campaigns and groups
- Browse saved views with their conversion event, model, and date range
- List the conversion and revenue events your reports run against

Every data tool is read-only. The connector cannot write, modify, or delete anything in your Attribution account. It connects over OAuth, queries live data with your existing dashboard permissions, and stores nothing on the AI side.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Attribution MCP to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Attribution MCP to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.attributionapp.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Attribution MCP MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Attribution MCP provides these MCP tools: get_cohort_report, get_dashboard_comparison, get_dashboard_report, get_filter_tree, get_filter_tree_markdown, get_project_context, list_attribution_models, list_event_names, list_project_views, log_report_issue, and logout.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Attribution MCP?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Attribution MCP in marketing-seo on the Manufact MCP catalog include Buzzfy, Airefs AI Visibility, TalkGenAI, RankControl, and attentive-mcp-server.

_published_faq.name: Does Attribution MCP MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Attribution MCP requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Attribution MCP is developed by Attribution Inc.. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
